summary: Implemented the first D1 exposure of the declarative construction plan: physics attention (the vendored lab's Transolver-style physics_attention1d) is now a backbone a miner can submit in the research catalog, with heads, slices and expansion as catalog fields, and depth and remat extended to it. Each field reaches the rebuilt model: the strategy vocabulary gains the name physics_attention additively, the research assembly registers carbon_jax_physics_attention1d, the reconstruction profile maps it, and the public capability catalogue lists it. A width that does not divide across the chosen heads is refused naming heads, and a field belonging to another family is refused as not applicable. The historical session catalog and the GPU diagnostic catalog are unchanged byte for byte - each keeps its own backbones, shown by comparing contract identities before and after - so widening the research catalog widens nothing else. The executed controls test gains cases in which heads, slices and expansion each change the rebuilt parameters, and ema_decay is now asserted through predictions rather than EMA state. No scoring rule, exam, tolerance, resource envelope or qualification changes; the attention family is DEVELOPMENT-rebuildable only.
